title: Safety Measures on Kilimanjaro: Oximeters, Oxygen and Evacuation
excerpt: Oximeters, emergency oxygen and evacuation plans: the safety measures that matter on a Kilimanjaro climb.
body:
## Daily health checks

Guides check oxygen saturation, pulse and symptoms, usually morning and evening.

## Emergency oxygen

Carried on every climb for emergencies.

## Evacuation

A plan for descent and, where possible, helicopter evacuation. Check your insurance. See [travel insurance for Kilimanjaro](/blog/kilimanjaro-travel-insurance/).

## Turn-around decisions

Guides can decide that a climber must descend. That is for your safety.

## Days

Enough days is the best safety measure. See [how many days](/blog/how-many-days-kilimanjaro/).

## Questions to ask

- What safety equipment is carried?
- How often are health checks done?
- What is the evacuation plan?

See [altitude sickness](/blog/kilimanjaro-altitude-sickness/) or [plan your climb](/travel-proposal/).
